title: Registry: the Harbor supply chain (push -> S3 blob -> Trivy -> cosign)
description: Demonstrates the Harbor supply chain the cluster bootstrap proves end-to-end: a docker push to registry.nexus.lab lands its blobs in MinIO s3://harbor, Trivy scans the artifact on push (scan_status Success), and cosign signs + verifies it. `nexus health registry` then shows the registry + trivy components healthy and the s3-backend canary green.

observe.what: the registry + trivy components are part of the 8/8 healthy checklist; s3-backend 200 confirms blobs are reachable on the MinIO S3 store

whatProves: The registry tier carries the platform supply chain: image blobs in MinIO EC, Trivy CVE scan on push, cosign signatures, behind Vault OIDC SSO. The adapter health surfaces the component checklist + the S3 backend that holds the layers.
